content.text: That was your last tool call. Call final_answer now.

input.final_sql:
select sum(f.PRS_REM_MNT) as reimbursed_amount
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION r on f.BEN_RES_REG = r.BEN_RES_REG
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY p on f.PSE_ACT_SNDS = p.PSE_ACT_SNDS
where f.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502
  and r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB = 'Ile-de-France'
  and lower(p.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB) like '%pharmac%'
